newsitem.title: GERMANY: Boehringer Mannheim recalls drug in India.
newsitem.headline: Boehringer Mannheim recalls drug in India.

text.p: German pharmaceuticals group Boehringer Mannheim on Monday said it had recalled its drug Comsat forte in India and shut down the plant in which it was produced after the drug allegedly caused two deaths.

Boehringer Mannheim said it had recalled four batches of the sulphonamide Comsat forte made by its Indian unit after discovering on Sunday that a material designed to reduce blood sugar levels had been added to the drug.
The group said two deaths and 70 separate cases of illness have been associated with those specific batches of the drug.
Boehringer Mannheim said it was cooperating with Indian health authorities to investigate the matter.
Boehringer Mannheim India Ltd shares are listed on the Bombay stock exchange.
